dogecoin.text: Dogecoin, like Bitcoin, has a finite supply and is backed by math. But Bitcoiners call it a scam. Such irony. Wow.
The only substantive difference between Dogecoin and Bitcoin is the latter's activists take themselves way too seriously.
How much of the Dogecoin fad stems from Bitcoin just being too tough to mine profitably anymore?

I mean, what is the origin of this?  Musk pulling back from crypto over Green Mining concerns?

Bitcoin has lost 50% of its value in 3 months.

Dogecoin has lost 80% of its value in 2 months.
